title: Haiti Turns to Roger Stone To Lobby Trump Administration
summary_full: The Haitian government hired Mr. Stone, a confidant of President Trump, weeks after hundreds of thousands of Haitians lost deportation protection. The contract is worth nearly $800,000, a document shows.
